{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders found in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA order IDs: {qa_orders["order_id"].tolist()}')

# Remove QA orders
completed_clean = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}')"}
